Policeman: *muffled* See? I told ya it was a waste of time. Asking a neet who never leaves his room if he knows something is just retarded. 
Policewoman:  *muffled* You said the R word…
Policeman:  *muffled* Ah… Sorry… I meant “not smart”. Please, don’t report this ok?...
I stopped hearing them after they went down the stairs and I think that’s a good thing. 
For clarification. I’m not a neet … I go outside for food and things like that. 
But man… I always thought this district was pretty peaceful. I wonder if something happened or maybe it really was just a routine check. Never had something like it before though. 
I should check out local news or something like that. I don’t think anyone would have the guts to destroy the Monument of Equality again. These two guys that did it last time were made an example of what happens when you defy our country's values.
